Class AnsiTerminalCapture

java.lang.Object
java.io.OutputStream
dev.tamboui.internal.record.AnsiTerminalCapture
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, Flushable, AutoCloseable
public final class AnsiTerminalCapture extends OutputStream
Captures raw bytes written to System.out for recording inline demos. Instead of parsing ANSI sequences into a virtual buffer, this captures the raw byte stream and replays it directly in the cast file.

This approach provides perfect fidelity - the cast file contains exactly what was written to stdout, and the asciinema player interprets the ANSI sequences correctly.

This is an internal API and not part of the public contract.
